name: UpdateEnhancedVpnGateway

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the enhanced VPN gateway instance. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 增强型 VPN 网关实例所在的地域 ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域 ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端 Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken 只支持 ASCII 字符。

> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用 API 请求的 RequestId 作为 ClientToken 标识。每次 API 请求的 RequestId 不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the enhanced VPN gateway instance
parameters.help_zh: 增强型 VPN 网关实例的 ID
parameters.name: vpn_gateway_id

parameters.help_en:
The new name of the enhanced VPN gateway.

The name must be 2 to 100 characters in length. It cannot start with http:// or https://. It must start with an uppercase or lowercase letter and can contain uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and periods (.). Other special characters are not supported
parameters.help_zh:
增强型 VPN 网关的新名称。

长度为 2～100 个字符，不能以http://或https://开头，需要以大写或小写字母开头，后面可包含大小写字母、数字、下划线（_）、短划线（-）和半角句号（.），不支持其他特殊字符
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The new description of the enhanced VPN gateway.

The description must be 1 to 100 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
增强型 VPN 网关新的描述信息。

描述信息长度为 1～100 个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the routing automatic propagation feature for the enhanced VPN gateway instance. Valid values: - **true**: enabled.
After routing automatic propagation is enabled, the enhanced VPN gateway instance uses automatic learning to obtain system routes from the system route table of the VPC instance and automatically propagates routes of the on-premises data center to the system route table of the VPC instance. - **false**: disabled.
Before you disable routing automatic propagation, make sure that BGP dynamic route is disabled for all IPsec-VPN connections under the enhanced VPN gateway
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启增强型 VPN 网关的路由自动传播功能。取值： - **true**：开启。
开启路由自动传播后，增强型 VPN 网关实例会自动学习 VPC 实例系统路由表中的系统路由，并向 VPC 实例系统路由表自动传播本地数据中心的路由。 - **false**：关闭。
关闭路由自动传播前，请确保增强型 VPN 网关下的所有 IPsec 连接已关闭 BGP 动态路由功能
parameters.name: auto_propagate
